text: Every Indian could stand inside one city.
Over 1.4 billion people, packed two to a square meter, the safe limit at a concert,
fill a square just 27 kilometers wide.
Pour it into Delhi, and it fills only half the city.
Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai — not a soul.
Now bring everyone on Earth, 8.2 billion.
Too big for Delhi, so fly it east into Sikkim,
It fits, with room to spare.
So next time someone says India is too crowded, tell them...
